stem:
Tanya hangs a wet shirt on a clothesline on a windy afternoon. Later the shirt is dry.

What has the liquid water become?

options.text: Liquid water again, because evaporation reverses itself at once
Water vapour only if the shirt had been boiling

teacher.key_rationale: Evaporation converts liquid water into water vapour. The dry shirt shows that conversion; the water has not become ordinary air, has not instantly reversed back to liquid, and does not require boiling.
